# Character-class data read out of the oracle's own ICU 78.2 (Unicode 17.0),
# which the built pdfium_test statically links. Three tables, each a list of
# inclusive code-point ranges in ascending order, one range per line:
#
#   [alpha]  START END          u_isalpha(cp) is true across the range
#   [alnum]  START END          u_isalnum(cp) is true across the range
#   [lower]  START END DELTA    u_tolower(cp) == cp + DELTA across the range
#
# All values are hexadecimal except DELTA, which is signed decimal. A code
# point in no range is non-alphabetic, non-alphanumeric, and maps to itself.
# See PROVENANCE.md for the probe that produced this.
